Outranks error and composeRows in the body-state precedence.

props.name: actionsRow
props.desc: S116: the Table Actions row rendered ABOVE the card, on the page canvas (Figma `Table Container` 5057:8509). Absent → no row. `count` (number|null|undefined) renders "1,284 items" via itemCountLabel, or an em dash while unknown. `stickyTop` is a VALUE, not a flag (number px or CSS length): PRESENT (incl. 0 — tested with != null, never truthiness) → the row leaves the VERTICAL scroll and parks at that offset, ABSENT → it scrolls away with the page. Never in the horizontal scroller either way, never a colSpan row inside <table>. A sticky row anchors the WHOLE band: the h-scroll track and column header park at actionsRow.stickyTop + the MEASURED row height (ResizeObserver), and the table-level stickyTop does not apply. Deviation from React: the trailing cluster (a ReactNode carried inside `actionsRow` there) is a content-projection slot here — project one or more elements with `slot="actions-trailing"` (not typed primary/secondary props: the toolbars this replaces needed one primary, one secondary, and TWO secondaries, so a fixed pair could not express all three). Rendered whenever actionsRow is present, same treatment as footer.

props.name: error
props.desc: S116: the THIRD body state (Figma `Table Container Error` 5065:8602) — two lines of label/xs in --text-error over a secondary "Reload" button (lucide refresh-cw), announced with role="alert". NO icon. Rows are SUPPRESSED but the header and actions row stay. Precedence: loading outranks it; it outranks composeRows. onRetry omitted → no button renders; retryLabel overrides the default "Reload".

props.name: composeRows
props.desc: S116: COMPOSE MODE — for tables built by hand rather than fetched. Renders the fourth body state (Figma `Fourth Content State`): centered supporting text over a SECONDARY "+" button, shown ONLY while the table has no rows; the first row added retires it. Opting in is manual. Deliberately does NOT switch on the actions row: getting from row 1 to row 2 is the consumer's own affordance (typically a control in [slot=actions-trailing]), because adding a row is a FLOW, not a single callback this component should dictate. Yields to loading.

props.name: detailColumns
props.desc: NESTED-TABLE FLAVOR. The second table's OWN columns — own keys, labels and widths, deliberately NOT aligned to `columns`. Setting this selects the flavor: an expanded group reveals a full second table instead of child rows. ⚠ READ THE EXPANDABLE ROW AS A DATA ROW, NOT A HEADER: in the Rows flavor the per-group row heads its children; here it heads nothing — it is an ordinary data row (one value per outer column via `values`, regular weight, the chevron merely living in its lead cell), and its header is the table's own `columns` row. An expanded group therefore shows TWO header rows belonging to TWO different tables — that is correct, not a duplicate.

props.name: detailSections
props.desc: N SIBLING nested tables, stacked, each genuinely independent: its own columns, its own widths, its own horizontal scrollbar, separated from the next by a hairline. For row detail that belongs to two or more NAMED groups which must not read as one flat run of columns (Dropped Carrier: Routing Details + Volume Commitment). The count is yours — pass three or ten. Every section reads the SAME `groups[].detailRows`: a section is a column set OVER those rows, not its own data. `note: true` picks which section hosts `detailNote` (default the first); `scroll` is a per-section override of [detailScroll], for the case where one sibling genuinely differs; `cellTemplate` overrides [detailCellTemplate] for that section alone. Mutually exclusive with [detailColumns] (which is sugar for a single section) — passing both THROWS. Actions never appear in a section: `groups[].action` belongs to the group row alone.

props.name: detailScroll
props.desc: Nested flavor, default false. Gives each nested table its NATURAL width with an independent horizontal scrollbar inside its band, instead of compressing its columns to the outer table's width. ONE input with the same meaning and default in both flavors: with [detailSections] it applies to every sibling, each scrolling in its OWN band, so a wide section never drags a narrow neighbour. Per-section `scroll` overrides it. Off, a ResizeObserver still self-heals a band into its own scroller if the nested table would otherwise overflow the outer table.

props.name: noteLines
props.desc: Lines a `detailNote` clamps to before a Show more / Show less toggle appears (default 3). The toggle renders only when the text ACTUALLY overflows — a one-line description offering "Show more" is a lie. 0 disables the clamp.

props.name: detailCellTemplate
props.desc: Optional renderer for the nested table's cells (Angular analogue of React renderDetailCell). Same `{ row, col }` context, with `row` a detailRows entry. Default: `row[col.key] ?? "--"`.

props.name: groups[].detailRows
props.desc: Rows for that group's nested table, keyed by detailColumns[].key. Only read in the nested flavor.

props.name: groups[].detailNote
props.desc: Optional full-width WRAPPING row at the bottom of that group's nested table, spanning every column of the section that hosts it (`note: true`, default the first) plus its filler cell. The SHORTHAND for one note per row — for a note on every sibling use `detailNotes`. Clamped to [noteLines] with a Show more toggle. For the one long free-text field among short ones (Dropped Carrier's Reason Description) — as a column it needs ~360px and pushes the rest off the scroll extent. Pass `{ label, value }` and the component renders and styles the label itself; a TemplateRef ($implicit = `{ group }`) is the escape hatch. Nested flavor only.

props.name: groups[].detailNotes
props.desc: ONE NOTE PER SIBLING: a map keyed by `detailSections[].key`, so each nested table can carry its own long-text row, each with its own clamp and Show more toggle. Siblings with no entry render no note. Wins over the `detailNote` shorthand for its own section, so a group may carry both. Nested flavor only.

props.name: groups[].actionTone
props.desc: Colour scheme (glyph + background) for that row's pinned action cell. Omit for the neutral default. At rest the tone reads as a tile behind the glyph; on hover the WHOLE 68px cell fills with the tone and the tile dissolves into it, glyph keeping its colour. This lives on the component rather than the slot because the hover fill is the CELL's background — a projected node cannot paint its own ancestor. An unrecognised value degrades to neutral.

The COLOUR SCHEME is not the slot's — see `groups[].actionTone`. Clicks are stopped from toggling the row.

props.name: name
props.desc: [profile] User display name.

props.name: role
props.desc: [profile] User role label shown below name.

props.name: [slot=avatar]
props.desc: [profile] Avatar element projected via slot. Clipped to 32×32 with lg radius.

props.name: notificationCount
props.desc: [profile] Badge count on the bell icon. Default 0.

props.name: showNotification
props.desc: [profile] Force-show/hide the notification badge independent of count.

props.name: showBell
props.desc: [profile] Show the Notifications (bell) icon button. Default true — false removes the whole button, not just the badge (that's showNotification).

props.name: showCustomers
props.desc: [profile] Show the Customers (handshake) icon button. Default true.

props.name: customersActive
props.desc: [profile] Active state for the customers button.

props.name: dropdownOpen
props.desc: [profile] Swaps chevron direction (down→up) when profile dropdown is open.

props.name: (customersClick)
props.desc: [profile] Customers icon click handler.

props.name: (notificationClick)
props.desc: [profile] Bell icon click handler.

props.name: (profileClick)
props.desc: [profile] Profile button click handler.

props.name: showPrimaryButton
props.desc: [editor] Show the primary (ghost) button. Default true. Label via primaryButtonLabel ('Cancel').

props.name: primaryButtonLabel
props.desc: [editor] Label for the primary button. Default 'Cancel'.

props.name: showSecondaryButton
props.desc: [editor] Show the secondary (outline) button. Default true. Label via secondaryButtonLabel ('Save').

props.name: secondaryButtonLabel
props.desc: [editor] Label for the secondary button. Default 'Save'.

props.name: showHelpIcon
props.desc: [editor] Show the help icon button. Default true.

props.name: helpIconName
props.desc: [editor] Lucide icon name for help button. Default 'circle-help'.

props.name: showRightIcon
props.desc: [editor] Show the right icon button. Default true.

props.name: rightIconName
props.desc: [editor] Lucide icon name for right button. Default 'x'.

props.name: (primaryButtonClick)
props.desc: [editor] Primary button click handler.

props.name: (secondaryButtonClick)
props.desc: [editor] Secondary button click handler.

props.name: (helpClick)
props.desc: [editor] Help icon click handler.

props.name: (rightIconClick)
props.desc: [editor] Right icon click handler.

props.name: className
props.desc: Additional class names merged onto the host.

props.name: variant
props.desc: Widget size/layout variant. Drives the content shape and width class.

props.name: title
props.desc: Widget header title.

props.name: domainIcon
props.desc: Projected domain icon — container slot for 3x/3xChart, inline slot for 1x/2x.

props.name: showGrip
props.desc: Show the GripVertical drag handle (edit-mode affordance). Default false.

props.name: showClose
props.desc: Show the header X close button (non-edit). Default false. (editMode always shows it.)

props.name: goToLabel
props.desc: Label for the footer link button (2x/3x/3xChart). Footer renders when set.

props.name: value
props.desc: Primary metric value (1x, 2x, 3xChart). Animates count-up once in view.

props.name: label
props.desc: Metric label below the value (1x, 2x, 3xChart).

props.name: percentage
props.desc: 2x only — center text rendered inside the donut chart (count-up).

props.name: rows
props.desc: Stat rows for 3x and 3xChart variants ({ label, value, indicatorColor? }).

props.name: chartSegments
props.desc: Donut chart segments (2x, 3xChart). color = a Chart/* token.

props.name: chartTotal
props.desc: 2x only — implied total for a single-segment percentage chart.

props.name: showChart
props.desc: 2x only — hide the donut for stat-only widgets. Default true.

props.name: chartDelayMs
props.desc: Delay in ms before the donut grow-in animation starts. Default 0.

props.name: ctaRows
props.desc: 3xCta only — call-to-action link rows ({ icon, label }), up to 4.

props.name: editMode
props.desc: Forces grip on, dims content, shows a close button wired to (remove). Default false.

props.name: (close)
props.desc: Emitted when the non-edit header close button is clicked.

props.name: (goToClick)
props.desc: Emitted from the 1x content area and the footer link.

props.name: (remove)
props.desc: Emitted when the edit-mode close button is clicked.

props.name: (rowClick)
props.desc: Emitted with the row index when a 3x/3xChart row is clicked.

props.name: (ctaClick)
props.desc: Emitted with the row index when a 3xCta row is clicked.

props.name: [slot=icon]
props.desc: 20px icon rendered inside the 40×40 carolina-blue icon container.

props.name: label
props.desc: CTA label text.

props.name: interactive
props.desc: When true the row renders as a <button> with hover/pressed state ladder and emits (clicked). Angular equivalent of React onClick presence.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.desc: Accessible label for the interactive button host.

props.name: (clicked)
props.desc: Emitted on click when interactive=true.

props.name: className
props.desc: Additional class names merged onto the host.

props.name: label
props.desc: Row label text.

props.name: value
props.desc: Metric value rendered inside an inline Badge (metric variant).

props.name: showIndicator
props.desc: Shows a filled dot to the left of the label. Default false.

props.name: indicatorColor
props.desc: CSS color for the indicator dot. Pass a chart token e.g. "var(--chart-2)". Default var(--chart-1).

props.name: interactive
props.desc: When true the row renders as a <button> with hover + chevron highlight states and emits (clicked). Angular equivalent of React onClick presence.

props.name: (clicked)
props.desc: Emitted on click when interactive=true.

props.name: value
props.desc: The metric count, 24/24 semibold. Counts up on load (Widget’s CountUp sweep) and recounts on activation, together with the donut. (Figma: Value TEXT prop.)

props.name: label
props.desc: The metric name under the count, label/xs medium DSN/600. (Figma: Label TEXT prop.)

props.name: percentage
props.desc: 0–100. Drives the donut sweep AND the "N%" center text. (Figma: Percentage TEXT prop — numeric in code.)

props.name: selected
props.desc: Active-filter state: border DSN/900 + shadow/sm; renders aria-pressed. Becoming selected (false→true) replays the donut grow-in + count-up. (Figma: State VARIANT Default|Selected.)

props.name: (clicked)
props.desc: The card is a <button> — a clickable filter toggle, not a passive Widget.

props.name: showChart
props.desc: Escape hatch for metrics without a share. Default true.

props.name: chartColor
props.desc: Donut arc color token. Default 'var(--ice-blue-600)' (the Figma binding).

props.name: className
props.desc: Extra class(es) merged onto the root button.

props.name: segments
props.desc: Segment data. color should be a Chart/* token (e.g. "var(--chart-1)").

props.name: size
props.desc: Donut diameter. md=72px, lg=96px. Pass a number for ad-hoc sizes. Default md.

props.name: centerText
props.desc: Optional text rendered in the donut center (e.g. a percentage).

props.name: total
props.desc: Optional denominator. When segment values do not sum to 100%, pass total so the rest renders as --chart-rest.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.desc: Optional ring thickness in px. Defaults to 18% of size (the Widget md/lg look); WidgetMini passes 9 for its slim 64px donut.

props.name: delayMs
props.desc: Delay in ms before the grow-in animation fires. Default 0.

props.name: play
props.desc: Gates the grow-in animation (lazy-load / scroll-into-view). Default true.

props.name: className
props.desc: Additional class names merged onto the host.

props.name: variant
props.desc: Currently displayed widget size. Controls which Widget variant renders in the preview slot. Default 1x.

props.name: widgetProps
props.desc: Forwarded (field-by-field) to the inner Widget — title, value, label, percentage, rows, chartSegments, chartTotal, showChart, domainIconName.

props.name: className
props.desc: Extra class(es) merged onto the host element.

props.name: (variantChange)
props.desc: Fired when the user clicks an arrow or a dot. Consumer owns the variant state.

props.name: title
props.desc: Panel heading. Default 'Metrics library'.

props.name: groups
props.desc: Item groups ({ id, title, items:[{ id, label }] }). Each renders as a collapsible MenuDropdown of MenuRow items.

props.name: searchValue
props.desc: Controlled search input value. Filters items client-side (case-insensitive label match). Default empty.

props.name: collapsedGroupIds
props.desc: IDs of collapsed groups. Normalized to a Set internally.

props.name: isItemDisabled
props.desc: Predicate — return true to disable a specific item.

props.name: (searchChange)
props.desc: Emitted on every search keystroke.

props.name: (toggleGroup)
props.desc: Emitted when a group header is clicked (carries the group id).

props.name: (itemClick)
props.desc: Emitted when a default MenuRow item is clicked.

props.name: <ng-template>
props.desc: Optional per-item template (Angular translation of React renderItem). Context: { $implicit: item, group, disabled }. Lets a consumer wrap each item with a DnD adapter without this package depending on it.
